The ethogram is first a partition between zero-output time and pollination-competent time. 1-2 investigation is by definition non-contact assessment; it can generate no pollinium pick-up or deposition and the insect is not on the umbel in a state capable of transfer. 3-4 interaction requires contact and is the only ethogram state in which Asclepias pollinia can move.

With 3 after 1 ⇒ 2 and 1 after 3 ⇒ 4 investigation and interaction strictly alternate and are mutually exclusive. The visitation budget for a given visitor on an umbel is therefore a partition between non-contact search time 2-1 and contact handling time 4-3. Time in contact per hour scales with n(3)/h × [4-3] and time lost to non-contact scales with n(1)/h × [2-1].

A regime where mean interaction bout 4-3 is much larger than mean investigation bout 2-1 converts approaches into sustained handling and spends the bulk of umbel time in a pollination-competent state, with very little loss to hovering, rejection or fruitless non-contact probing between contacts. Per arrival that increases flowers touched, the chance of pollinarium attachment and removal within and between flowers of the umbel, and raises the rate at which pollination-competent visits can be delivered to the population of umbels.

Feeding 5-6 is nested in interaction, 3 < 5 < 6 < 4 and 4 after 5 ⇒ 6, so 6-5 ≤ 4-3 on every admissible bout. 4-3 >> 6-5 is therefore essentially built in by the nesting and describes mostly non-feeding contact: handling, resting or lingering after the nectar price has been paid. In milkweed effective pollinia transfer is mechanistically coupled to probing at the hoods/cornua, i.e. to feeding-associated contact. Prolonged contact without feeding does not create additional pick-up/deposition and it holds the visitor on one umbel and off the next, reducing inter-umbel movement.

Investigation is pollination neutral on its own, but it is an opportunity cost in the pollinator time budget. It is time not in 3-4, and at the population level it reduces the rate at which contact bouts can be delivered. Maximising sustained contact handling relative to non-contact investigation is the cleanest first-order signal of increased pollination service. That is 4-3 >> 2-1, the bout-duration expression of n(3)/h >> n(1)/h.

n(1)/h >> n(3)/h is contact poor, n(5)/h >> n(3)/h raises nectar cost per contact bout, and 6-5 >> 4-3 is impossible under nesting. Getting the insect out of the zero-output investigation state and into sustained contact is the pattern with the greatest positive effect on plant fitness.

A. 4-3 >> 6-5

With the coding constraints the only admissible feeding bout is
1 < 2 < 3 < 5 < 6 < 4

3 after 1 ⇒ 2 and 1 after 3 ⇒ 4 enforce strict alternation of investigation 1→2 and interaction 3→4, and 4 after 5 ⇒ 6 makes feeding 5→6 a proper sub-bout of interaction, 3 < 5 < 6 < 4. Hence on every admissible bout 6-5 ≤ 4-3 so 6-5 >> 4-3, B, is logically impossible, and D n(5)/h >> n(3)/h would be >1 feeding onset per interaction onset on average, i.e. repeated nectar loss per contact window. E n(1)/h >> n(3)/h is contact poor.

Under the ethogram as stated 1-2 investigation is non-contact and is pollination neutral and nectar neutral to the plant. 3-4 interaction is the contact-competent window, the only ethogram state in which Asclepias pollinia can be picked up or deposited. 5-6 feeding is the reproductive cost to the umbel and is nested in 3-4.

Net plant gain per contact bout ≈ benefit ∝ 4-3 – cost ∝ 6-5, with 2-1 fitness neutral in the formal cost model. Investigation is cost free to the plant under the stated definitions, so the primary net-fitness lever under the ethogram as written is the contact-to-nectar-cost ratio nested inside a contact bout, not contact versus investigation time alone.

Camp A – Colleagues 11,12,2,3,8: plant fitness ≈ benefit ∝ contact time 4-3 minus cost ∝ feeding time 6-5, investigation 2-1 is fitness neutral under the formal coding. The plant-relevant control inside a visit is ratio [4-3]/[6-5]. 4-3>>6-5 is high benefit/low cost: long pollination-competent contact window per unit nectar lost, pollination opportunity per nectar is maximised because the interaction can stay open after the nectar price is paid.
